title: Omwoyo Ow'omuwendo Eyabuuza Obuyinza
intro: Mu bitabo by’ebyafaayo bya Quran, mwalimu omuntu obugagga bwe n’okumanya kwe byafuuka eby’olugero. Omwoyo guno gwava mu nsi n’eby’okwewunda n’obugagga obwali buwuniikiriza abatunuulizi, naye omutima gwabwe ne gwegulumiza olw’amalala. Twegatteko nga bwe tusumulula ekyama ky’emu ku nfumo za Quran ezisinga okwegendereza, obukulu bw’ebintu gye busisinkana enkomerero eyeetoowaze wansi w’ettaka lyennyini eryazaala omukisa gwabwe.
clues: Nava mu nsi nga nyooyooteddwa n’eby’okwewunda ebyakwata amaaso ga buli muntu.
Nnalina obugagga bungi nnyo n’okumanya okw’amaanyi okwanjula ku balala.
Omubaka bwe yajja ng’ayita abantu eri Allah, nabuusabuusa obuyinza bwabwe n’amalala.
Abo abaali banneetoolodde bankuba enduulu nti ekisa kya Allah si kye nsibuko y’obugagga bwange.
Abantu bange beewuunya obukulu bwange era ne baagala enkomerero efaananako n’eyange.
Ebizimbe byange eby’ekitalo byamira byonna mu nsi ng’ekibonerezo eky’obwakatonda.

arabic: وَقَـٰرُونَ وَفِرْعَوْنَ وَهَـٰمَـٰنَ ۖ وَلَقَدْ جَآءَهُم مُّوسَىٰ بِٱلْبَيِّنَـٰتِ فَٱسْتَكْبَرُوا۟ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَمَا كَانُوا۟ سَـٰبِقِينَ
verse: And [We destroyed] Qārūn and Pharaoh and Hāmān. And Moses had already come to them with clear evidences, and they were arrogant in the land, but they were not outrunners [of Our punishment]. (29:39)
